# Psalm 43 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

## 43:1 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** Judge-me, O-God, and-plead my-cause against-an-ungodly nation; from-the-man of-deceit and-injustice deliver-me.
- **LOGOS:** Vindicate me, O God, and defend my cause against an ungodly people, from the deceitful and unjust man deliver me!
- **PNEUMA:** Declare me innocent, O God! Defend me against these ungodly people. Rescue me from these unjust liars.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

- **LOGOS:** Why are you cast down, O my soul, and why are you in turmoil within me? Hope in God; for I shall again praise Him, my salvation and my God.
- **PNEUMA:** Why am I discouraged? Why is my heart so sad? I will put my hope in God! I will praise Him again — my Savior and my God!
